newsitem.title: USA: California's Night Stalker weds on Death Row.
newsitem.headline: California's Night Stalker weds on Death Row.

text.p: Richard Ramirez, the feared "Night Stalker" convicted of torturing and murdering 13 people, married a 41-year-old freelance magazine editor on Thursday in a Death Row wedding at San Quentin prison.
Ramirez married Doreen Lioy, who said she fell in love with Ramirez at first sight, in a civil ceremony at the prison near San Francisco, San Quentin spokesman Vernell Crittendon.
"As I observed it, I saw an absence of emotion on Richard Ramirez's face. I saw in her eyes the look of a woman in love," Crittendon said.
Following the wedding ceremony, Lioy told reporters, "I'm happy and very, very proud."
The San Francisco Examiner reported last week that his bride is a Catholic who vowed to remain a virgin until marriage.

The devil-worshipping Ramirez terrified Los Angeles in the mid-1980s with his sadistic crimes, torturing, sexually abusing and killing victims. Arrested in 1985 he was convicted four years later and sentenced to death. Appeals are still pending and no date has been set for his execution.
The couple were married by a justice of the peace in the prison ceremony, Crittendon said. The couple exchanged rings but there were no flowers.
They kissed three times and embraced during the ceremony, he said. Lioy wore a traditional white wedding gown and Ramirez, 36, wore a clean, well-pressed prison uniform.
They were one of three "Death Row" couples married on Thursday at the prison, the prison spokesman said. The couple will not be allowed conjugal visits.
